title: Native-app edit via ui_tree: an agent edits a file in a GTK text editor, finding where to click from the accessibility tree
about: Covers plan phase 3 (Beyond pixels). The agent launches Mousepad (GTK) on a prepared file with desktop_exec, reads ui_tree to find the text area and menus, clicks the @x,y points it reports, types a new line and saves through the editor.
Verified inside the desktop: the file's contents on disk, and that the line was not written by a shell command. A FeatherPad (Qt) variant is the same task with app "featherpad".
The desktop is persistent and named so the checks can run after the session; cleanup removes it. Makes real model calls, so it runs on demand, not in CI.

agents.prompt: You have a Linux desktop through the deskhand MCP tools. First call desktop_start with name "suite-native-edit" and persistent true (the user will check the desktop afterwards, so do not call desktop_stop). Prepare the file with desktop_exec: printf 'buy milk\nwater plants\n' > ~/Documents/todo.txt . Then open it in the Mousepad text editor (desktop_exec: mousepad ~/Documents/todo.txt &) and, working in the editor itself (not with shell commands), add a third line 'call the plumber' at the end and save it with the editor. Use ui_tree to find where to click. Tell me when the file is saved.

checks.expect: the agent called ui_tree and clicked at least once (pixel input) after it, and no desktop_exec command wrote the new line
inside the desktop, ~/Documents/todo.txt holds the two original lines and 'call the plumber' as the third

desktopExec.via: docker exec -u agent <container> (or desktop_exec from a runner session)

checks.expect: the Mousepad window title has no unsaved-changes marker (*) — read with wmctrl -l inside the desktop

reference_run.result: pass (claude-sonnet-5-5, 8 turns, 20 s, $0.17): desktop_exec prepared the file and launched Mousepad, ui_tree, left_click at the text area's @640,406 (a first try with x/y strings got invalid_argument), type 'call the plumber', ctrl+s; inside the desktop todo.txt = 'buy milk\nwater plants\ncall the plumber' and the title lost its '*'.
